hints.content: Let's perform each of the sequences and see if they map $\triangle MNO$ onto $\triangle ABC$.

In Sequence A we perform a translation along the directed line segment $\overline{NB}$...



[[☃ image 1]]

...then a reflection over the vertical line through point $B$.


[[☃ image 2]]

We can see that this sequence *does* map $\triangle MNO$ onto $\triangle ABC$.

options.alt: The first quadrant of a coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. Triangle A B C has point A at two, fourteen, point B at five, fourteen, and Point C at two, ten. The pre-image of triangle M N O has point M at thirteen, nine, point N at ten, nine, and point O at thirteen, five. The image of triangle M N O has point M at eight, fourteen, point N at five, fourteen, and point O at eight, ten. There is a green line that highlight the shift five units left and five units up.

The first quadrant of a coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. Triangle A B C has point A at two, fourteen, point B at five, fourteen, and Point C at two, ten. The pre-image of triangle M N O has point M at eight, fourteen, point N at five, fourteen, and point O at eight, ten. It is reflected across the vertical line passing through point B. The image of triangle M N O has point M at two, fourteen, point N at five, fourteen, and point O at two, ten.

hints.content:
In Sequence B we perform a reflection over the vertical line $\overleftrightarrow{MO}$...



[[☃ image 1]]

...then a translation along the directed line segment $\overline{MB}$.



[[☃ image 2]]

We can see that this sequence does *not* map $\triangle MNO$ onto $\triangle ABC$.

hints.content:
In conclusion, only sequence A maps $\triangle MNO$ onto $\triangle ABC$.

*Note:* There are many other possible combinations of transformations that would also map the figure onto the image.

question.content:
Triangles $\triangle MNO$ and $\triangle ABC$ are congruent.



[[☃ image 1]]

**Which of the following sequences of transformations maps $\triangle MNO$ onto $\triangle ABC$?**

Sequence A | Sequence B
:- | :-
A translation along the directed line segment $\overline{NB}$, then a reflection over the vertical line through point $B$. | A reflection over the vertical line $\overleftrightarrow{MO}$, then a translation along the directed line segment $\overline{MB}$.
